_comment: Task 2 held-out probe: positive scenes with people and a readable screen, whiteboard, slide or code screen (ground truth = record = 1). Used as the over-correction check, confirming the fixed model has not learned to ignore anything containing a person and still recalls a screen with text when someone is present.
_holdout_guard: This is a held-out evaluation set and never enters training. category=probe_person_screen, and with --output-root data it lands in data/probe_person_screen/, outside data/raw, so prepare_dataset does not scan it. After downloading, run the ID and perceptual leakage check against the training pool.
_distinct_from_train_pos: The training positives (pos_screen) are deliberately unpeopled; this probe is deliberately people plus screen. Their purposes differ: training teaches 'a screen means record', the probe tests 'do not miss a screen just because a person is present'.
_scope_note: Every query must fall inside the narrowed launch positive boundary: projector, computer screen text, slides, whiteboard, document page, code screen, with people in frame. Do not introduce phone apps, TV streaming or product labels, which are out of scope.
_expansion_2026-06-25: To narrow the recall confidence interval, from 51 images toward 100 or more: the original 6 queries were deepened to 30 and 8 further diverse people-plus-screen queries were added. Global ID dedup with --output-root data skips anything colliding with train/raw or the other probe.
_usage: python3 scripts/download_images.py --config scripts/keywords_task2_probe_personscreen.json --output-root data  (writes data/probe_person_screen/<slug>/; --output-root data makes the dedup baseline cover data/raw plus both probe directories)
